adjudication.rationale: In the new `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler, the code does a `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } })` followed by either `credential.update` or `credential.create`. This check-then-act pattern is not atomic, so two concurrent webhook deliveries for the same `userId`+`appSlug` can both observe “no credential” and then both execute `create`, producing duplicates if the DB allows it; or, if a unique constraint exists, one `create` will throw and is not handled here (resulting in a 500). An upsert/transaction/unique constraint handling would be needed to make this safe.
